as_told.title: Sardinian giant graveyard cleared by men in vans and tower passage sealed

plain: Some time in the 1920s or 1930s, men ploughing land for a vineyard near a nuraghe, one of Sardinia's ancient stone towers, suddenly 'start unearthing the remains of gigantic people.' The documentary maker Tim Alberino tells Michels he heard this from a 101-year-old named Anna Tuary, who remembered it. In a second telling Alberino adds that vans pulled up, people got out with equipment while the witness hid, the remains were taken away, and a passage in a tower was sealed off, which would mean someone deliberately removed evidence of giants.
